title: Every screen at once, and edits that save themselves.
notes: More than one screen: the capture overlay now covers every screen at once. Select, click a window or press Enter on whichever screen you like; Screen lets you click the screen to take.
Edits save themselves a moment after you stop, and the library's preview follows, sharper than before. The Save button is gone (⌘S / Ctrl+S still saves at once).
The editor opens with the tool you used last.
Highlighter: starts 8 thick and keeps its own thickness; hold Shift to stay on the line you started on.
Guides: "Made with Rega" links to the Rega website.
